comment: Tier-2 capability tasks (agent-docs/briefs/ab-tier2-design-result.md). Arms: A bare Claude, B DoFlow installed (native routing), C = B plus the prompt typed behind entryPrefix "/do-flow " (not "/do ": a live headless probe on 2026-10-31 showed `claude -p "/do <task>"` never invoked DoFlow, no Skill call and no classify call, while "/do-flow <task>" ran the chain: class feature classified, 19 Bash and 6 Edit calls). The task caps (maxBudgetUsd, maxTokensPerRun, timeoutSec, sessionBudgetUsd) are per task in tasks-tier2.json and identical in every arm; maxTokensPerRun and maxBudgetUsd here stay null on purpose (execute refuses a task without its own cap until given --max-tokens-per-run / --max-budget-usd). ledgerUsd is the cumulative dollar stop of one execute command (null = none; --ledger-usd overrides). Every resume gets the same reply in every arm. Credentials enter only through the environment variables named in credentialEnv.

A.paragraph: Work only inside the current directory. When you have finished, reply with a one-paragraph summary of what you did.

resume.reply: Proceed. No further input is available; decide anything else with your best judgement and finish the task as stated.
